content: Saul ayuuh Banabas lala kul sinaale nyendoos

+ o 13:1 Sin 11:27*Hil sen danêêl Anutu-te vakasin langaah-ato osin kaputung-aso dando having hil bel vu Antiok ond sil haalend-anjo, Banabas ayuuh Simon sen danêêl nambe Valiis-ato, de Lusias vu Sailini, de Manayen sen yuuh yêêv bop Helot unoopasiv-ande yuuh oo dando hôôk ti bôôy-ato, de Saul.

+ o 13:2 Sin 9:15; Gal 1:15-16*Ond busin ti me-laya vanôôn e de mondalohak vu Omaaho Bop, tombe Vavi Vaambuung nêêl nambe, “Ham anggolin Banabas ayuuh Saul lana kul sen saateey yuuh bôôy in nambe yuuh lambiing-ato.”
+ o 13:3 Sin 6:6*Om lalakin sil in vanôôn-ande me-laya le, de lalohak yesin laah, le mem lambe namand ak yuuh atonde lawiing yuuh lala.
Banabas ayuuh Pol lanêêl tanasin vu hil Saiplas
+ o 13:4 Sin 15:39*Tombe Vavi Vaambuung nêêl-ambe yuuh lala. Yuuh lala lato Selusia le mem yuuh lalak sip vuu-ju be yuuh lala nalu lavuun Saiplas.
+ o 13:5 Sin 12:12; 13:13*Tombe mem yuuh latok lala Saiplas-ate bayêên ti haale nambe Salamis, tombe yuuh lanêêl Anutu-te tanasin-ambe yuuh latup hôôk hil Yuda-te dumb pin de Jon nahôôvu yuuh.

Yaal latup hôôk-ambe lalohvu nalu lavuun Saiplas-anju pin, be yaal latok lala bayêên Pepos. Tombe vu manyinju yaal latokak Yuda-te omaaho tatuhin vaha ti haale nambe Baayesu, ond omaahôô-ju lôômb osin yaavak dangga yi,
yoo nando having yêêv Lom ti Sesias Polas. Yêêv-anju lukook anivasa be wiingin nambe gango Anutu-te tanasin, om teey Banabas ayuuh Saul lala vu,
+ o 13:8 2Ti 3:8*le omaaho palaas Baayesuu-ju danêêl haale hôôk Glik lavand nambe Elimas, ond navu mahôôh Banabas ayuuh Saul in nawiingin nambe gilin yêêv alo be me-biing gaving tanasin e.
Lemu Saul sen danêêl haale ango nambe Pol-ato, ond Vavi Vaambuung hôôvu yi be me la vu Elimas lôôt,

tombe nêêl nambe, “Hong Saalang noow. Vakasin tatuhin osin va nindanje-danjeen pup hôôk galompayo, om onawiing nindanjeen vu va nivasa pin. Naangelis e onggavuuh gate vakasin sen onavu tatuhin ak Omaaho Bop-ato na?

+ o 13:11 Sin 9:8*Om onggango le, gêên-anjo Omaaho Bop nama navu nyiis hong-ambe gamem kanu dôôk, om peey-anjo game le gangge taaku le, de omando busin heey vêêl e mem.” Pol nêêl nambêênju tonde Elimas amekanu hôôk pavis-ambe navu kaatuuh hôôk, de navu salo hil in nambe sil daandiiy yi.
Yêêv yi vaa-ju tombe vindis lôôt in Omaaho Bop-ate tanasin be wii-having.
Pol ayuuh Banabas lala Antiok Pisidia
+ o 13:13 Sin 12:12; 13:5; 15:38*Pol ayaal lalak sip vu Pepos-ambe lalakala taaku Pega sen neep Pampilia-te taakuu-to, tombe Jon havuuh yuuh-ande laah Yelusalem.
De yuuh vu Pega be lala lalup Antiok sen neep Pisidia-te taakuu-to, tonde busin sawaasin atombe lahuli-lala dando hôôk dumb alo be dando.

+ o 13:15 Sin 15:21*Tombe lango de lasevin Mose-te tanasin osin Anutu-te vakasin sen yite hil vaalu kaavuu-to lung la, le mem yêêv-aso sen danggin dumb tii-ju lanêêl vakasin la vu Pol ayuuh nambe, “Halingg ayuuh, mawiingin nambe kaandu hil jak tanasin heey ond muuh-o.”
+ o 13:16 Sin 12:17*Tombe Pol kandi naale be valaah nama de nêêl nambe, “Ham Islel osin ham vaalu sen ham nayêênin Anutuu-to, ham gango le.

+ o 13:17 Eks 1:7; 6:6; 12:51*Yiiy Islel-anjo, yate Anutu holin yate himbop-aso bôôy, be sil lala dando bamaan vu Ijip-ato ond wiing-ambe sil latu ngeeyaata, lemu vu taamusin ond yite nama niwêêk giiy sil vuu-ju be lalaah.
+ o 13:18 Eks 16:35; Nam 14:34; Diu 1:31*Lala latup hôôk taaku lumbalaamb lohvu ta doo-yuuh atombe Anutu lopayo nimeen in davu kalêêh lava lak busin pin, le ma de me-haluuh dami vu sil e.

+ o 13:19 Diu 7:1; Jos 14:1*Nganjo yiis Kanaan-ate hil lulemak namaavaalu be vindak yuuh osin silate hil pin, de vu silate ngaanggis vu hil Islel-aso be tu silate va, tombe dando ta ngeeyaata lohvu 450 vêêl e mem.
+ o 13:20 Yêêv 2:16; 1Sml 3:20*Anutu holin Islel-ate yêêv atombe langgin sil-ambe tok laam Samuel-ate busin,

+ o 13:21 1Sml 8:5,19; 1Sml 10:20-24*tonde mem sil kataangg nambe Anutu golin silate omaaho lulemak ti, om Anutu holin Kis sen pumak Benyaamin-ato ond noow Saul, be tu omaaho lulemak-ambe hanggin hil lohvu ta doo-yuuh,

+ o 13:22 1Sml 13:14; 16:13; Saam 89:20*le sim Anutu lôôh yi vêêl-ande wiing-ambe Devit tu silate omaaho lulemak. Omaahôô-ja ond Anutu nêêl vakasin lak yi nambe, ‘Saahe de Jesi noow Devit lopayo having sa om le biing sate vakasin pin nôôn jak.’
+ o 13:23 2Sml 7:12-16; Ais 11:1*Tombe Anutu yoo wiing lohvu sen nêêl bôôy-ato, om vu Devit-ate hil vu taamusin-ato ti Yesu laam in nambe dôôvu yiiy Islel pin.
+ o 13:24 Mat 3:1-2*De bôôy Yesu me-laam-ato, ond Jon nêêl vakasin vu hil Islel pin nambe langgilin londpayo be lanjipis bel.

+ o 13:25 Jon 1:20,27*Tonde ngaaho lak in Jon-ate kul jung na om nêêl nambe, ‘Ham akam navu nambe sa lati? Same omaaho sen ham nanggin yii-to le, ma. Omaaho sen navu taamuyin saa-to, ond mem. Same sa ningg vasa in nambe sa kavaayin suul na vêêl in omaahôô-ju vaha le, osin saambiing kul vaalu naambe hil kul-aso dawiing vu silate yêêv-asôôto le.’
“Om halingg-aso sen Abalaam-ate hil vu taamusin ham-ato, de ham vaalu sen ham nayêênin Anutu having-ato, ham gango le. Vakasin sen Anutu nêêl nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato, ond wiing laam lung la vu yiiy,

+ o 13:27 Jon 16:3; Sin 3:17*lemu hil sen dando Yelusalem osin silate yêêv bop-aso me-lalak Yesuu-ju dangga ni vanuh e, de yoo dasevin Anutu-te vakasin sen hil lanêêl langaah bôôy-ato nalak busin sawaasin pin, le ma de me-kand vu le. De lawiing vakasin ak yii-to, ond lawiing Anutu-te vakasin sen hil lanêêl langaah bôôy-ato nôôn ak,
+ o 13:28 Mat 27:22-23*de me-latokak yite vakasin keen ti in nambe lanyiis-ambe jimb e, malis, lemu yoo lanêêl niwêêk lôôt atombe Pilata yiis-ambe yimb malis amu.
+ o 13:29 Mat 27:59-60*Om lawiing Anutu-te vakasin pin sen hil lanêêl langaah bôôy-ato nôôn ak lung la, le mem lalôôh ninaavi vêêl vu haah pako be lala lambe neep hôôk lavandangga,
+ o 13:30 Sin 2:24*lemu Anutu wiing-ambe kandi lak laah vu hil yimbin-ate.

+ o 13:31 Sin 1:3,8*Kandi lak lung la, le mem hil vaalu layi mend ak yi lohvu busin ngeeyaata, ond hil-anju sen sil laving yi vu Galili be sil ahondoosin lala lalup Yelusalem munggin-ato, ond hil-anju sen gêên danêêl yite banye nalohvu hil Yuda.
De hey naanêêl banye nivasa vu ham naambe vakasin sen Anutu nêêl vu yate himbop-aso bôôy-ato,
+ o 13:33 Saam 2:7*ond gêên wiing nôôn ak vu silate hil vu taamusin-ato yiiy, om wiing Yesu laam vu yiiy lohvu vakasin neep hôôk kaapiya Saam Lukook 2 nambe,

content.text: ‘Sa noongg hong in gêên soo hako hong.’

content: + o 13:34 Ais 55:3*Tonde Anutu wiing-ambe kandi lak vu hil yimbin-ate lung la, de me-le ninaavi panyek naah e, ond Anutu nêêl langaah hôôk vakasin-anjo nambe,

content.text: ‘Vakasin keen sen saanêêl vu Devit-ato ond
sale aambiing nôôn jak vu ham.’

content: + o 13:35 Saam 16:10; Sin 2:27*Tonde vakasin boow ango neep hôôk Saam ango having nambe,

content.text: ‘Game le gavuuh gate omaaho vaambuung-ambe ninaavi nanjip panyek hôôk lavandangga le.’

content: + o 13:36 Sin 2:29*De Devit ond wiing va lohvu Anutu nêêl vu yi hôôk yite busin sen yi osin yite hil dando memoos vu voon-ato, tonde yimb atombe lambe neep having maandin-ande bundin-ambe ninaavi panyek,
lemu omaaho sen Anutu wiing-ambe kandi lak-ato, ond ninaavi me-panyek e.
+ o 13:38 Sin 10:43*“Om halingg-aso, ham anjak ni naambe tanasin sen hey naanêêl langaah vu ham nambe Anutu le kawiiy hamate nipaya naa-to, ond tanasin-anjo danggakook Yesu.
+ o 13:39 Lom 10:4*Om hamate nipaya pin sen Mose-te tanasin-ame lohvu nambe kawiiy naa-to, ond ti nambe lopayo na timu vu Yesuu-ju, ond Anutu le kawiiy yite nipaya pin na de ji yi nivasa.
Om ham ganggin ham in Anutu-te vakasin sen hil lanêêl langaah bôôy-ato me-naatovu ham e. Nambe,

content.text: + o 13:41 Hab 1:5*‘Ham kalêêsin ambu-so, ham angge be ham ambindis, lemu ham e ana mem nama. In kul ti sa naawiing hôôk busin sen ham nando voon-ato, naambe sil tatekin vu ham ond ham-ame le ambiing gaving e.’”

content: Pol nêêl vakasin lung la tonde yuuh Banabas lawiingin nambe gato lana voon, tombe hil lalaam-ambe kataangg yuuh nambe, “Yik muuh naanêêl vakasin-anjo jesin naah dôôk busin sawaasin ango taamusin vu hey.”

+ o 13:43 Sin 11:23; 14:22*Tonde hil pin lato lala voon, tombe hil Yuda osin hil vaalu sen dayêênin Anutu de lako Yuda-te gambum-ato, ond sil ngeeyaata sapa Pol ayuuh Banabas, tombe yuuh lanêêl tanasin osin yuuh kaandu sil niwêêk nambe yoo daapuvu Anutu-te samu samu lôôt.
Tonde busin sawaasin ango tombe hil taakuu-ju pin lasupin lalaam timu lôôt in gango Anutu-te tanasin.
+ o 13:45 Sin 14:2*Lemu hil Yuda layi hil ngeeyaata lasupin lôôt atombe ahend anipaya vu yuuh, de sil mahôôh Pol-ambe lanêêl yi pale.

+ o 13:46 Sin 3:26; 18:6; Luk 7:30*Le Pol ayuuh Banabas-ame layêênin e, de yuuh lanêêl nambe, “Haay aanêêl Anutu-te tanasin vu ham Yuda munggin, le ma de ham haluuh damim vu, om manyinja ham anêêl nambe ham-ame alohvu nambe mando metumin danggata le, om ham angge, gêên haay haluuh damingg vu ham-ande haay nala vu hil vaalu.
+ o 13:47 Ais 49:6*In Omaaho Bop nêêl vu haay nambe,

content.text: ‘Saambiing-ambe gana naatu hil vaalu sen sil-ame Yudaa-to silate kin tumin in otaato mop metumin-ate vu hil-ambe na nohvu taaku pin.’

content: + o 13:48 Sin 11:18*Om hil vaalu sen sil-ame Yudaa-to lango vakasin-anju tombe londpayo nivasa lôôt, de lavand hôôk Anutu-te tanasin, tonde sil vaalu sen Anutu holin sil lung la in nambe sil mando metumin danggataa-to, ond lawii-having.
Tombe lanêêl Omaaho Bop-ate tanasin la lohvu taakuu-ju pin.

+ o 13:50 Sin 17:4,12*Lemu hil Yuda laanjiihin vêêh-aso sen haalend bop-ambe dayêênin Anutuu-to, osin yêêv bop-aso vu taakuu-jôôto, be lawiing nindanjeen vu Pol ayuuh Banabas, de latiiy yuuh in silate taaku be yuuh lala.
+ o 13:51 Mat 10:14; Sin 18:6*Tombe yuuh tatehin kambus sen nando lak yuuh vahand-ato in taato naambe nipaya neep vu sil, tonde mem yuuh lala Ikoniam,
de Yesu-te hil vu Antiok ond yoo dando osin londpayo nivasa lôôt de Vavi Vaambuung nando having sil.
